svg.title: Stand-up to task board: extract, pull board context, update or create
svg.desc: Stand-up 1: the board is empty. Step 1 extracts three jobs, all said as new. Step 2 finds nothing on the board, so Step 3 creates three cards. Stand-up 2: for each thing said, Step 1 extracts who, what and what was said. Step 2 pulls that person's open cards and any cards on the same equipment from the board. Step 3 picks the matching card and updates it: the fire alarm test to done, the GT1 readings to in progress, the contractor booking to blocked. Ordering parts for the Atlas has no match and was said as new, so a card is created. Testing the long belt has no match and is not new, so it is ignored. The next stand-up pulls its context from this board.

g.text: Every stand-up: extract what was said, pull each person's cards from the board, then update what exists and create what doesn't.

Built as a local POC (GPT-5.6 Luna, 24 synthetic stand-ups): 96% of updates exactly right, the right card in the pulled context 100% of the time
with 4.4 cards on average instead of the whole board, and 21 of 22 update remarks with no card ignored. The board lives in a JSON stand-in database.
